name: AVA 数据分析
description: Analyze local CSV and Excel files with verified computations and interactive charts.
description_zh: 分析本地 CSV 和 Excel，核对指标变化，生成结论、结果表和交互图表，无需额外模型密钥。
description_en: Analyze local CSV and Excel files, verify metric changes, and produce results and interactive charts without another model key.
examples_zh: 分析我上传的 CSV，核对收入变化
分析我上传的 Excel，找出收入变化最大的产品
核对各产品变化之和，并生成图表
examples_en: Analyze my CSV and verify revenue changes
Analyze my Excel and find the largest product changes
Reconcile product contributions and create a chart
